title: East Lancashire Railway to host first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day
excerpt: East Lancashire Railway is inviting prospective volunteers to its first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day at Bury Bolton Street Station on Monday 12 October.
body:
East Lancashire Railway (ELR) is inviting prospective volunteers to its first Event, Catering and Retail Volunteer Open Day on Monday 12 October 2026.

The railway is looking for volunteers to help support a wide range of experiences, from luxury dining services and Rail Ale Trails to Days Out with Thomas and Santa Specials.

Volunteering opportunities cover events, catering and retail, with roles designed to suit a range of interests and experience. Volunteers could find themselves serving cream tea aboard a first-class carriage or helping to create the atmosphere for the Halloween Ghost Train.

The ELR said it will help match volunteers with roles that suit their interests and experience, with full training provided. No previous experience is needed.

Commercial Manager Lorna Kelly said: “If you’ve ever thought about volunteering at the East Lancashire Railway but felt unsure, or wondered whether you have the right experience, please come along to our Open Day. I’ll be there with some of our lovely volunteers, who can tell you what it’s really like to be part of the ELR.

“You can meet our events, catering and retail teams, hear about the roles available and ask any questions you have. Whether you’re ready to sign up or just curious, we’d love to meet you.”

The Open Day will take place at the Trackside Bar at Bury Bolton Street Station from 10am to 3pm on Monday 12 October.

The railway says prospective volunteers can attend to find out more about the roles available, meet members of the teams and ask questions before deciding whether to get involved.

Source: East Lancashire Railway.
